item.title: Ex-Slayer Icon DAVE LOMBARDO Shares What He Really Thinks About Today’s Metal Drummers
item.description: Original SLAYER drummer Dave Lombardo remains a pillar of the metal community, and in a new interview with Brazil’s Rádio Kiss FM 92.5, he offered an optimistic take on the current generation of metal drummers and the genre’s future.

item.title: The Backstage Incident That Made KERRY KING Call a Rock Icon a 'Complete Jerk'
item.description: Not everyone in the world of music gets along, and that includes some of its biggest stars. Even in heavy metal, a genre known for its intensity and larger-than-life personalities, there are musicians who just don’t click.
